rete-graph 0.7.8
Upstream: https://github.com/caviri/rete
License: Apache-2.0

The file rete-graph.min.js is copied unchanged from the npm package
`rete-graph` during `npm run dev` / `npm run build` by
`web/scripts/copy-rete-vendor.mjs`. It is loaded only by the SPARQL page's
web worker and is not part of the main JavaScript bundle.
